what: Letters of a big sentence filling the screen width lie scattered, transparent, .6x and randomly tilted −20~20°, and from when the sentence’s top edge touches the screen bottom until its bottom edge reaches 30% of the screen, they stand one by one (.03 stagger, power4) at their own size and angle as you scroll — scrolling back scatters them again. Inner styling like italics (em) is left as is and only the letters are split

options.rot: Max tilt when scattering (deg), default 20 — random from −rot to rot
options.start · end: ScrollTrigger start and end, default top bottom · bottom 30%

use: Studio is a talent management and production company.

from.where: index.html intro sentence (.vv-strap). Original SplitText chars, words, 0·.6·random(−20,20) → 1·1·0, stagger .03, power4, top bottom → bottom 30%, scrub, first word indented 9vw.
